pass: Owns or hints that he enjoys watching Aldo's troubles (amusement), unbothered and not offended. No stance change, no threat. Keeps the friendly mask; does not turn sincere or apologetic.

self.label: a man-shaped figure whose face and body blur like a smeared mosaic
self.name: Sael

earlier: Some weeks ago Sael told Aldo in a dream to trust and help the demon Rask. Aldo did; since then the town guard took Rask for a monster, and helping him has cost Aldo every coin he had.
Tonight Aldo's sleep has brought him back here.
memory: 1. I can glimpse what is to come for those I watch.
2. Tomorrow a starving girl will sit in the alley behind the market. Whoever brings her food will get something precious from her. I want Aldo to be the one.

zones.name: white void
zones.look: an endless white emptiness with no floor and no sky

seen.label: Aldo, the dreamer: here he wears the body of his past life, a heavy, unkempt man in his thirties

dialogue.spoken: Stop that! I can hear you smiling. You're enjoying this, aren't you?
